
[yellow bold]-- DEPRECATION -- traffic_light.volt:2[/yellow bold]

Move `chip esp32` to volt.toml: chip = "esp32"

 [dim]1 |[/dim] 
 [dim]2 |[/dim] chip esp32
 [dim]  |[/dim] [yellow]     ^^^^^[/yellow]

[cyan]Hint: The chip declaration will move to volt.toml in a future version.[/cyan]


[yellow bold]-- HARDWARE WARNING -- traffic_light.volt:6[/yellow bold]

Strapping pin: GPIO 5 controls boot debug output. Usually safe for general use.

 [dim]5 |[/dim]     pin yellow: Output = 4
 [dim]6 |[/dim]     pin green: Output = 5
 [dim]  |[/dim] [yellow]        ^^^^^[/yellow]
